Definition: from G2641; a remainder, i.e. (by implication) a few:--remnant.
BiblicalUsage: Even so at this present time there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the remnant is God's proof that He has never left Himself without a people, even when the numbers look small.
